e.title: IBM Blockchain Insurance App
e.summary: IBM 区块链保险演示应用（767★，Hyperledger）：四参与方理赔流程（经典但停更）
e.body: Build Blockchain Insurance Application（IBM/build-blockchain-insurance-app，767★）是 IBM 官方示例：展示区块链在保险理赔流程的应用——保险/警局/修理厂/商店四参与方各有 peer 节点：保险方处理索赔、警局验证盗窃索赔、修理厂负责维修、商店售出商品（Hyberledger/IBM Blockchain Platform）。注意：仓库已不再维护。对 RIAA：区块链保险理赔的经典演示（2017 起，767★ 历史重要性）——与 [[hurricaneguard]]（Etherisc 参数险合约）、[[insurancea2amcp]]（现代 agent 理赔）对照区块链+保险的演进；理解许可链多参与方理赔协作模型。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：IBM Hyperledger 区块链保险理赔演示（四参与方），767★（停更经典）
e.summary_en: IBM blockchain-insurance demo app (767★, Hyperledger): four-party claims workflow (classic but unmaintained)
e.summary_hk: IBM 區塊鏈保險演示應用（767★，Hyperledger）：四方參與理賠流程（經典但停更）
e.body_en: Build Blockchain Insurance Application (IBM/build-blockchain-insurance-app, 767★) is an IBM official sample: it showcases blockchain in the insurance claims workflow — four participants (insurance / police / repair shop / shop) each own a peer node: the insurer processes claims, the police verifies theft claims, the repair shop handles repairs and the shop sells products (Hyperledger / IBM Blockchain Platform). Note: the repository is no longer maintained. For RIAA: the classic blockchain-insurance demo (since 2017, historically significant at 767★) — compare [[hurricaneguard]] (Etherisc parametric contracts) and [[insurancea2amcp]] (modern agentic claims) to see the blockchain+insurance evolution; understand the permissioned-chain multi-party claims-collaboration model.
e.body_hk: Build Blockchain Insurance Application（IBM/build-blockchain-insurance-app，767★）是 IBM 官方示例：展示區塊鏈在保險理賠流程的應用——保險/警局/修理廠/商店四參與方各有 peer 節點：保險方處理索賠、警局驗證盜竊索賠、修理廠負責維修、商店售出商品（Hyperledger/IBM Blockchain Platform）。注意：倉庫已不再維護。對 RIAA：區塊鏈保險理賠的經典演示（2017 起，767★ 歷史重要性）——與 [[hurricaneguard]]（Etherisc 參數險合約）、[[insurancea2amcp]]（現代 agent 理賠）對照區塊鏈+保險的演進；理解許可鏈多參與方理賠協作模型。
